title: Mom's Amex Offers Round 1: List Layout, 3 Plain Steps, Bigger Dates And Amounts, Undo, Footer, Gentle Accent
brands: Mom's Amex Offers: an info-only app on Jane's phone, not a sales page
White base, near-black ink, Khand/Hind, big readable type, one gentle accent at most
content_note: All offers are fake examples (Corner Bakery Co., Green Leaf Grocery, etc.); no account data.
